verdict.rationale: Pulumi lets customers choose their own state-storage location via the DIY backend (self-managed S3/Azure Blob/GCS buckets in any region) and offers self-hosting of the Pulumi Cloud backend, giving some control over data residency. However, there is no documentation of region selection or residency guarantees within the managed Pulumi Cloud service itself, and no independent verification of residency compliance. Missing for 10: explicit Pulumi Cloud region/residency options, compliance certifications (e.g., GDPR/data-residency statements), and independent confirmation of self-hosted deployments meeting residency requirements.
